parent_result: VEC-v1-to-v3 source-only falsification and root-cause audit
scope: exploratory retrospective leave-one-centre-out study of case-intrinsic scanner-position evidence sets
claim_boundary: Deletion counterfactuals quantify model dependence on observed within-case evidence units. They do not identify lesions, establish causal pathology mechanisms, establish acquisition-time savings, or provide clinical deployment validation.
outer_split: reuse the five Formal-v1 leave-one-centre-out assignments; all policy and hyperparameter fitting is source-only

sequence_units.oct_unit: all ten raw frames sharing one parsed C/S machine position field
sequence_units.colposcopy_unit: one acquired colposcopy view; no lesion region is inferred
sequence_units.position_semantics: scanner-position identifier only until confirmed by device/acquisition documentation

representation_plan.oct_primary: frozen RETFound OCT initialization, treated as an out-of-domain foundation-feature ablation rather than cervical-domain validation
representation_plan.oct_control: frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 pooled over the identical ten-frame C/S cluster
representation_plan.colposcopy: frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 view feature with a modality-specific fusion projection

image_encoder.name: torchvision_resnet50_imagenet1k_v2
image_encoder.raw_frame_control: the fifth frame from the same parsed C/S position; this isolates ten-frame cluster pooling from a matched single-frame representation

policy.note: The ranking can inspect all retained case evidence; this is an offline evidence-retention analysis, not a prospective acquisition-time policy.

method_modules.M3: within-case deletion-counterfactual minimality objective and audit

source_only_ablation_families.A1_raw_fixed: M1 removed: same-C/S fifth-frame tokens, fixed three-unit attention retention
source_only_ablation_families.A2_cluster_fixed: M1 only: ten-frame C/S cluster tokens, fixed three-unit attention retention
source_only_ablation_families.A3_cluster_adaptive: M1+M2: cluster tokens with adaptive offline sufficiency retention, no M3 loss
source_only_ablation_families.A4_ices_full: M1+M2+M3: cluster tokens, adaptive offline sufficiency retention, and deletion-minimality objective

test_lock.outer_test_use: one frozen exploratory LOCO evaluation after all source-only gates pass
test_lock.interpretation: The parent study has already used the same cohort in prior experiments, so this is retrospective exploratory transport evaluation, not an untouched confirmatory test. A sixth hospital is required for confirmation.

unavailable_evidence.reviewed_roi_polygon_or_bbox: not available; no lesion-localization or clinical-semantic-grounding claim is permitted
unavailable_evidence.device_order_confirmation: not yet documented; C/S groups are reproducible machine fields but anatomical order requires local verification
